data.body: S1 T1 CLOSED (2c81 vivacious-widish-indianabat) on evidence: Gerrit 1880 LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 (CI run 32198575083 success), 27/27 held-out tests green, all 8 ACs ticked with a per-AC test-evidence map recorded as a ticket comment. Close gate friction worth noting for the rest of the run: ticking AC checkboxes is attestation-SAFE, but I first appended '(evidence: ...)' text to each AC line, which changed the reviewed MATERIAL (3729 -> 5026 chars) and staled the attestation; reverting to pure ticks at exactly 3729 chars and moving the evidence into a comment cleared it without spending a second review-plan. Do ticks-only in the description from here on. Transition unblocked 34f2 evadable-curious-mastodon (S1 T2).
